title: A Safehouse for the Ghost
author: Ines Sterling
blurb: Mirabel Galloway, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, works cases no one wants attributed. Then a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
